header.pot: Pot: {{pot}} chips (shared out by tricks taken)
header.risk: Enter and take fewer than {{required}} trick(s) and you pay an extra {{penalty}} into the pot — and your ante doubles next hand.

watching: You dropped out of this round. Watching it play out.

hint.julepePlayIn: You hold trumps or high cards — this is worth playing.
hint.julepePassOut: Little chance of a trick. Drop out and lose only the ante.
hint.julepeTakeTrick: No trick yet. Take one to avoid the extra payment.
hint.julepeAlreadySafe: One trick is banked. Now take what you can.

tutorial.pot: Chips staked on this round, shared out among whoever takes tricks. It grows every time a player owes the extra payment.
tutorial.decide: Look at your hand and the trump card, then choose. **Dropping costs only the ante**; playing and taking no trick costs more.
tutorial.trick: Cards played this trick appear here. Trump beats everything, then the led suit.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Legal cards carry a green ring. The first goal is simply to bank one trick.

dealerAria: the dealer this round (deciding and leading start to their left)
